function.name: get_site_info
function.description: Returns site settings, resource counts and appPlanning presence (present, missing). Presence does not prove valid planning. Before changing an existing App, read current Blueprint/App Plan and affected resources, then analyze planning impact. Planning changes require review_app_requirements; unchanged planning permits scoped maintenance. Failed reads are not absence.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
